description: Floated down the Nile on her own fuzz. One bite and Rome forgets what it came for.

name: ABRAHAM LIME-COLN
description: Four score and seven squeezes ago. The stovepipe is simply the tallest lime in the crate.

name: ARCHIMEDEAS
description: Shouted Eureka so hard it left a dent in the copper. The screw was a bonus invention for the olives.

name: VINCENT VAN GRAPE
description: Painted the starry night and then rolled it into jam. The stem was a rough morning. The palette never recovered.
